description: Land Title Settlement Department - Barawawila, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510012 and other title settlements
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including details about land ownership, property boundaries, cadastral information, and land registration particulars. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category.
